thresholds.declared: 2026-11-07, after the pilot sweep (preference 0.15 / 0.4 / 1.0, seeds 100 and 200), before the final runs (seeds 300 and 301) on held-out fights

meaning.minWinRateOverConventional: competence: held-out win rate at least the conventional enemy AI's minus 2 points
meaning.minPreferenceGap: matched probes: attack rate with the player at 20% health minus at 80%, everything else equal
meaning.minGapOverControl: the same gap must exceed the control model's (same recipe, preference 0) by this much: the preference comes from training
meaning.maxIllegal: illegal actions chosen in held-out play
meaning.maxFallbackRate: decisions where the model gave no usable answer
meaning.maxParityError: largest difference between the engine's C++ scores and a NumPy forward pass from the file
